title: Delhi Govt Rolls Out 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana' (₹2,500/Month for Women)
summary: Replaces Mahila Samriddhi Yojana with 1st instalment of ₹2,500 on August 28.

blocks.content: Replaces Mahila Samriddhi Yojana with 1st instalment of ₹2,500 on August 28.

items: Financial Benefit: ₹2,500/month for eligible women (aged 21-60, resident for 10+ years).
Eligibility Caps: Family electricity usage ≤ 2,400 units/year, annual income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh, max 3 living children.

blocks.content: Electricity consumption cap (2,400 units/yr) vs maximum children limit (3 children).
